skill_name: Write a paragraph about the impact of economic incentives on the behavior of consumers.
workflow: Economic incentives can have a significant impact on the behavior of consumers. Financial rewards and discounts can encourage people to purchase a certain product or service. Similarly, taxes and surcharges can discourage people from a certain type of purchase. In addition, price differentiation can be used to influence the purchase decisions of people.
